cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC World Service 的《Global News Podcast》。

cues.en: I'm Alex Ritson, and in the early hours of Monday, 14 September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是亚历克斯·里特森。9月14日星期一凌晨，以下是本节目的主要新闻。

cues.en: Sweden's election authorities predict a slim majority for the left-wing opposition in a close parliamentary race.
cues.zh: 瑞典选举机构预计，在势均力敌的议会选举中，左翼反对派将以微弱优势获得多数席位。

cues.en: Ukrainian Railways says Russia may have been targeting a train carrying senior European diplomats in a drone attack.
cues.zh: 乌克兰铁路公司称，俄罗斯无人机袭击可能原本针对一列载有欧洲高级外交官的列车。

cues.en: And Turkish police detain dozens of people after sweeping raids at LGBT venues.
cues.zh: 土耳其警方在对 LGBT 场所展开大规模搜查后，拘留了数十人。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, a tragic story resulting from the mafia's grip on a family.
cues.zh: 本期还将讲述一个悲剧故事：一个家庭深受黑手党控制。

cues.en: The death of Denise Cosco is the last episode, let's say, of a family saga.
cues.zh: 可以说，丹妮丝·科斯科之死是一个家族悲剧的最后一幕。

cues.en: And in tennis, none of us have ever seen anything quite like that at the end of a Grand Slam final.
cues.zh: 网球方面，大满贯决赛以这样的方式收场，我们谁都未曾见过。

cues.en: We're at Flushing Meadows for the US Open men's final.
cues.zh: 我们正在法拉盛草地，关注美国网球公开赛男单决赛。

cues.en: We begin in Sweden, where Sunday's general election remains too close to call as the vote count continues.
cues.zh: 我们先来看瑞典。随着计票继续，周日举行的大选仍然难分胜负。

cues.en: Initial exit polls suggested a victory for the left-wing opposition.
cues.zh: 最初的出口民调显示，左翼反对派可能获胜。

cues.en: Celebrations were jubilant as results came in for the coalition's largest party, the Social Democrats.
cues.zh: 该联盟最大政党社会民主党公布选举结果时，支持者欢欣鼓舞。

cues.en: This will be a great change for Sweden, for democracy—a better future. It's really hopeful, I would say.
cues.zh: 这将给瑞典和民主带来巨大改变，带来更好的未来。我觉得这真的很有希望。

cues.en: I would say it shows that, with some luck, we'll still see whether the polls hold up in the actual election.
cues.zh: 我会说，这说明只要运气好，我们仍能看到民调是否在实际选举中经受住了检验。

cues.en: I hope this marks the beginning of the end for the right-wing movement.
cues.zh: 我希望这标志着右翼运动走向终结的开端。

cues.en: In their latest update, election authorities project that the left-wing bloc will win a three-seat majority in parliament.
cues.zh: 选举机构最新预计，左翼阵营将在议会中获得三席的多数优势。

cues.en: The far-right Sweden Democrats saw their support fall, but some results have yet to be declared.
cues.zh: 极右翼的瑞典民主党支持率下降，但部分选举结果尚未公布。

cues.en: BBC Monitoring's Matilda Vellin has been following developments.
cues.zh: BBC 监测部的玛蒂尔达·韦林一直在跟进事态发展。

cues.en: She says it may take a while before we get a definitive result.
cues.zh: 她说，我们可能还要等一段时间才能得到最终结果。

cues.en: Forming a government may take longer than getting an initial election result, because Sweden has eight parliamentary parties.
cues.zh: 组建政府可能比得出初步选举结果花费更久，因为瑞典议会有八个政党。

cues.en: The way they collaborate provides the basis for deciding whom they approve as prime minister.
cues.zh: 各党如何合作，将成为决定他们认可谁出任首相的基础。

cues.en: At Sweden's last election, four years ago, it took around a month for the parties to agree on a prime minister.
cues.zh: 瑞典上一次大选是在四年前，各党花了大约一个月才就首相人选达成一致。

cues.en: Four years before that, it took so long that parliament did not approve a prime minister until after Christmas.
cues.zh: 再往前四年，协商耗时之久，以至于议会圣诞节后才批准首相人选。

cues.en: The final votes are likely to be counted this coming Wednesday.
cues.zh: 最后一批选票可能要到本周三才会计完。

cues.en: So, most likely, we'll know which of the two main blocs—the right-wing bloc or the centre-left bloc—will have the most seats.
cues.zh: 因此，我们很可能会知道两个主要阵营——右翼阵营和中左翼阵营——哪一方席位更多。

cues.en: After that, it will probably be possible to guess who will become prime minister.
cues.zh: 之后，大概就能推测谁会出任首相。

cues.en: Opinion polls had predicted a victory for the far right.
cues.zh: 民调此前曾预测极右翼会获胜。

cues.en: But election authorities suggest those polls were wrong and that the left-wing coalition is likely to be ahead.
cues.zh: 但选举机构的预测显示，民调可能错了，左翼联盟很可能领先。

cues.en: I wouldn't call it a far-right victory: for most of the last century, the Social Democrats have been Sweden's biggest party.
cues.zh: 我不认为这是极右翼的胜利：过去一百年里，社会民主党在大部分时间都是瑞典最大政党。

cues.en: That was always expected in this election too.
cues.zh: 这次选举中，人们原本也一直预期会是如此。

cues.en: Though the Social Democrats likely had one of their worst election results in a century,
cues.zh: 尽管社会民主党此次很可能创下过去一百年来最差的选举成绩之一，

cues.en: they are still Sweden's biggest party. Such is their dominance.
cues.zh: 他们仍是瑞典最大的政党，其主导地位可见一斑。

cues.en: When people call the Sweden Democrats election victors, they mean the party has rocketed in support.
cues.zh: 人们称瑞典民主党是选举赢家，指的是该党的支持率大幅攀升。

cues.en: They entered parliament only 16 years ago, in 2010, and have increased their support at every election since.
cues.zh: 他们直到16年前的2010年才进入议会，此后每次选举支持率都有所上升。

cues.en: Four years ago, they became the second-biggest party, behind the Social Democrats.
cues.zh: 四年前，他们成为第二大政党，仅次于社会民主党。

cues.en: Does that mean migration is perhaps no longer quite the issue it has been in recent years?
cues.zh: 这是否意味着，移民问题或许已不像近年那样受到关注？

cues.en: Migration has very much still been discussed in Sweden during the election and campaigning.
cues.zh: 移民议题在瑞典仍然备受讨论，也是此次选举和竞选活动中的重要话题。

cues.en: How will Sweden change as a result of this election?
cues.zh: 这次选举会给瑞典带来什么变化？

cues.en: What seems likely right now is that there will be a shift of prime minister.
cues.zh: 目前看来，首相人选很可能会更替。

cues.en: We'll go from the conservative prime minister, Ulf Kristersson, to a Labour or Social Democrat prime minister, Magdalena Andersson.
cues.zh: 首相将从保守派的乌尔夫·克里斯特松换成工党或社会民主党人玛格达莱娜·安德松。

cues.en: But again, we'll see how these parties negotiate with one another.
cues.zh: 不过，还要看这些政党彼此如何协商。

cues.en: Matilda Vellin.
cues.zh: 玛蒂尔达·韦林报道。

cues.en: Ukraine's state railway company has said it's quite likely Russia was seeking to attack a diplomatic train.
cues.zh: 乌克兰国家铁路公司称，俄罗斯很可能试图袭击一列外交列车。

cues.en: It was carrying some of Europe's most senior security officials.
cues.zh: 车上载有欧洲一些最高级别的安全官员。

cues.en: On Sunday morning, the train was passing through a station in Ukraine near the Polish border and had left earlier than planned.
cues.zh: 周日早上，这列火车经过乌克兰一座靠近波兰边境的车站；它比原计划更早出发。

cues.en: Soon after leaving Warsaw, a Russian drone hit another train at the same station.
cues.zh: 列车离开华沙后不久，一架俄罗斯无人机袭击了同一车站的另一列火车。

cues.en: The train had been evacuated and no one was injured, but this passenger said she was terrified.
cues.zh: 列车上的乘客已疏散，无人受伤，但这名乘客说她吓坏了。

cues.en: We were travelling on the train. This was already our third evacuation.
cues.zh: 我们当时乘坐火车。这已经是我们第三次撤离了。

cues.en: We were woken in the middle of the night.
cues.zh: 我们在半夜被叫醒。

cues.en: I looked out of the window and saw people starting to run.
cues.zh: 我朝窗外看去，发现人们已经开始奔跑。

cues.en: We had to. I realised something had happened, and we needed to act quickly.
cues.zh: 我们不得不……我意识到出事了，我们必须迅速行动。

cues.en: But then I heard the explosion. So I told the children to run out of the carriage quickly, in whatever they were wearing.
cues.zh: 但接着我听到了爆炸声。所以我让孩子们赶紧跑出车厢，穿着什么就穿什么。

cues.en: I grabbed my rucksack with my documents, and we all ran out too.
cues.zh: 我抓起装着证件的背包，我们也都跑了出去。

cues.en: Russia's defence ministry said it had attacked railway infrastructure used to transport military cargo.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯国防部称，俄方袭击了用于运输军事货物的铁路设施。

cues.en: Ukraine's Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha gave this warning.
cues.zh: 乌克兰外长安德里·瑟比哈发出以下警告。

cues.en: Russian strikes are now hitting right next to the Ukrainian-Polish border. Specifically, a strike was carried out today.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯的袭击如今正发生在乌克兰与波兰边境旁。具体来说，今天就发生了一次袭击。

cues.en: President Putin's terror is literally knocking on the doors of the European Union and NATO.
cues.zh: 普京总统的恐怖行动确实已逼近欧盟和北约的大门。

cues.en: That is precisely why partial measures are insufficient.
cues.zh: 这正是为什么零敲碎打的措施远远不够。

cues.en: Mr Sybiha went on to call for continued military support for Ukraine and tougher sanctions against Russia.
cues.zh: 瑟比哈接着呼吁继续向乌克兰提供军事支持，并对俄罗斯实施更严厉的制裁。

cues.en: The drone is understood to have struck two kilometres from the Ukraine-Poland border.
cues.zh: 据悉，这架无人机袭击的位置距乌克兰与波兰边境两公里。

cues.en: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk held an emergency meeting to discuss what he called Russia's escalation of actions.
cues.zh: 波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克召开紧急会议，讨论他所称的俄罗斯行动升级。

cues.en: Our diplomatic correspondent James Landale is in Kyiv.
cues.zh: 本台外交事务记者詹姆斯·兰代尔正在基辅。

cues.en: Over the last couple of days, there has been a big conference here in central Kyiv. It's an annual event, and an awful lot of VIPs have been in town.
cues.zh: 过去几天，基辅市中心举行了一场大型会议。这是年度活动，许多重要人士都来到城里。

cues.en: A lot of people were on a special train organised by the conference.
cues.zh: 许多人乘坐了由会议组织的专列。

cues.en: And the thing is, this train followed a very familiar route—the same one other world leaders take when they leave Ukraine.
cues.zh: 关键在于，这列火车走的是一条非常熟悉的路线——其他世界领导人离开乌克兰时也走这条路。

cues.en: It's the same route US envoys took last weekend when they came here from Moscow and then went back out again.
cues.zh: 上周末，美国特使从莫斯科来到这里、随后离开时，走的也是这条路线。

cues.en: So this is a familiar route. It's not secret; people know where it is.
cues.zh: 所以这是一条熟悉的路线，并不是什么秘密，人们都知道它在哪里。

cues.en: This train passed through the border, and an hour later a Russian drone struck a train at the station.
cues.zh: 这列火车经过边境一小时后，一架俄罗斯无人机袭击了车站里的一列火车。

cues.en: The train operator says it is quite likely that Russia was targeting that special diplomatic train.
cues.zh: 铁路运营方称，俄罗斯很可能是在瞄准那列外交专列。

cues.en: What this shows, I think, is Russia's new tactic of targeting not just trains but also border positions.
cues.zh: 我认为，这表明俄罗斯出现了一种新战术：不仅袭击列车，也袭击边境阵地。

cues.en: In recent days, there have been attacks on the borders with Romania and Moldova.
cues.zh: 近几天，罗马尼亚和摩尔多瓦边境都遭到袭击。

cues.en: A pattern is forming here as part of a broader escalation now under way.
cues.zh: 这里正在显现一种模式，属于目前正在发生的更大范围升级的一部分。

cues.en: Secondly, what's interesting is that General David Petraeus, the former US CIA chief, was also at this conference.
cues.zh: 其次，有意思的是，美国中央情报局前局长戴维·彼得雷乌斯将军也出席了这场会议。

cues.en: He was on a slightly different train, but he was at the station just outside when the attack took place.
cues.zh: 他乘坐的火车略有不同，但袭击发生时，他就在外面的那个车站。

cues.en: He's been quoted as saying that he now believes this was a deliberate attempt by the Russians.
cues.zh: 据引述，他现在认为这是俄罗斯方面的一次蓄意行动。

cues.en: They were trying to close that western border to deter Western visitors from coming to Ukraine.
cues.zh: 他们试图封锁乌克兰西部边境，以阻止西方访客前往乌克兰。

cues.en: These attacks so close to NATO territory raise, at the very least, the possibility of mistakes or miscalculation.
cues.zh: 袭击发生在如此靠近北约领土的地方，至少带来了出错或误判的可能。

cues.en: Some of these attacks could go wrong—not on Ukrainian soil, but on NATO soil.
cues.zh: 这些袭击中有些可能出岔子，落在北约领土上，而非乌克兰境内。

cues.en: As we've seen throughout this conflict, sometimes that is tolerated, and NATO turns a blind eye.
cues.zh: 正如我们在这场冲突中屡见的，有时这种情况会被容忍，北约也会视而不见。

cues.en: But at a certain point, NATO members may well decide that enough is enough.
cues.zh: 但到了某个时候，北约成员国很可能会认为不能再忍下去了。

cues.en: And I think that is part of Russia's strategy of pushing NATO, as it has for many, many months, if not years, to see how and when it will respond.
cues.zh: 我认为，这也是俄罗斯逼迫北约的策略之一；这种做法已持续许多个月，甚至可能多年，目的是试探北约何时、如何回应。

cues.en: James Landale.
cues.zh: 詹姆斯·兰代尔。

cues.en: Up to now, Russia's economy has remained surprisingly resilient despite international sanctions and the massive cost of the war in Ukraine.
cues.zh: 迄今为止，尽管受到国际制裁并承担乌克兰战争的巨大成本，俄罗斯经济仍出人意料地保持韧性。

cues.en: But businesses are struggling, fuel shortages are growing, and many Russians say they're feeling the strain.
cues.zh: 但企业正陷入困境，燃料短缺日益加剧，许多俄罗斯人表示自己感受到了压力。

cues.en: Our reporter Ed Butler asks whether the cost of the war is finally beginning to bite.
cues.zh: 本台记者埃德·巴特勒探问，战争的代价是否终于开始显现。

cues.en: Filling up at petrol stations in Russia seems to be getting increasingly stressful these days.
cues.zh: 如今，在俄罗斯的加油站加油似乎变得越来越令人焦虑。

cues.en: This was an argument over alleged queue-jumping.
cues.zh: 这是一起因涉嫌插队而起的争吵。

cues.en: Russians sometimes have to wait six hours or more to fill their fuel tanks.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯人有时得等上六个小时甚至更久，才能给油箱加满油。

cues.en: The reason? Well, largely, it seems to be due to Ukraine's sustained drone attacks on Russia's oil refineries.
cues.zh: 原因是什么？看来很大程度上是乌克兰持续使用无人机袭击俄罗斯炼油厂所致。

cues.en: And not just those.
cues.zh: 而且不止这些。

cues.en: Ukraine has extended its attacks to retail warehouses as well, like the Wildberries chain, known as Russia's Amazon.
cues.zh: 乌克兰还把袭击扩大到零售仓库，例如被称为“俄罗斯亚马逊”的 Wildberries 连锁企业。

cues.en: This was the scene of panic after a recent strike in Yekaterinburg.
cues.zh: 这是叶卡捷琳堡最近一次袭击后发生恐慌的现场。

cues.en: Some small business owners who store their products inside Wildberries say they've been ruined.
cues.zh: 一些把商品存放在 Wildberries 仓库的小企业主说，他们已经被彻底毁了。

cues.en: That's it. That's over. My brand officially no longer exists.
cues.zh: 完了，一切都结束了。我的品牌正式不复存在了。

cues.en: We have nothing left: no inventory and no savings.
cues.zh: 我们什么都不剩了：没有库存，也没有积蓄。

cues.en: I've been wiped out. I'm officially broke.
cues.zh: 我已经彻底完了，正式破产了。

cues.en: But is it really so bad across Russia as a whole?
cues.zh: 但整个俄罗斯的情况真的有这么糟吗？

cues.en: Yes, it's true that inflation and interest rates are up, but President Putin points out that unemployment remains low.
cues.zh: 没错，通胀和利率确实上升了，但普京总统指出，失业率仍然很低。

cues.en: And in a press conference last month, he said the economy was actually still growing.
cues.zh: 他上个月在一场记者会上还说，经济实际上仍在增长。

cues.en: Economic dynamics are generally modest but positive.
cues.zh: 经济总体走势温和，但仍为正增长。

cues.en: GDP growth is around 1%.
cues.zh: 国内生产总值增幅约为1%。

cues.en: It is clear that economic growth is affected by external pressure and terrorist attacks.
cues.zh: 显然，经济增长受到外部压力和恐怖袭击的影响。

cues.en: But economists say this growth is unsustainable in the long term because only government spending is driving it.
cues.zh: 但经济学家表示，这种增长无法长期持续，因为推动增长的只有政府支出。

cues.en: The state coffers are running low, the deficit is rising, and low unemployment may not be the sign of strength Vladimir Putin claims.
cues.zh: 国库资金日渐紧张，赤字不断上升；失业率低，未必像弗拉基米尔·普京所说的那样代表经济强劲。

cues.en: There are growing rumours about what will happen after Vladimir Putin's expected victory in this month's election.
cues.zh: 关于弗拉基米尔·普京在本月选举中如期获胜后将会发生什么，传闻越来越多。

cues.en: In this highly authoritarian state, the election is presumed to be a formality.
cues.zh: 在这个高度威权的国家，这场选举被认为只是走过场。

cues.en: According to those rumours, his government will launch another round of mobilisations, forcing hundreds of thousands into the armed forces.
cues.zh: 根据这些传闻，他的政府将启动新一轮动员，迫使数十万人加入武装部队。

cues.en: Some, like this man who has just crossed the border into Georgia, are posting online that they aren't waiting to find out.
cues.zh: 有些人，比如这位刚越境进入格鲁吉亚的男子，正在网上发帖说，他们不愿坐等事态明朗。

cues.en: Folks, it's the end of August, the end of the holiday season. People are fleeing Russia.
cues.zh: 朋友们，8月底了，假期季节也结束了。人们正在逃离俄罗斯。

cues.en: Queues at the borders are growing by the hour.
cues.zh: 边境排队的人群每小时都在增加。

cues.en: But be aware: the Russian authorities will try to close this escape route. They will create obstacles.
cues.zh: 但要注意，俄罗斯当局会设法堵住这条逃生通道。他们会制造障碍。

cues.en: Sergey Petrov is a former Russian billionaire who built a car sales and rental business from nothing in the 1990s.
cues.zh: 谢尔盖·彼得罗夫曾是俄罗斯亿万富翁，20世纪90年代白手起家，创办了汽车销售和租赁业务。

cues.en: Now the Kremlin critic lives in exile.
cues.zh: 如今，这位克里姆林宫批评者流亡海外。

cues.en: He says the steady brain drain of wealthier Russians fleeing abroad is now a factor.
cues.zh: 他说，富裕的俄罗斯人不断外逃、造成人才流失，如今已成为一个影响因素。

cues.en: Next year, maybe over the next two years, it might happen. People are asking, 'Why are we here?'”
cues.zh: 明年，或许未来两年内，这种情况可能会发生。人们开始问：“我们为什么还在这里？”

cues.en: The situation in society could reveal many unstable things that we can't predict or see yet.
cues.zh: 社会局势可能会显露出许多不稳定因素，而我们现在还无法预料或看见它们。

cues.en: Russia is so unpredictable. There are no rules; they don't believe in the rules, and that could have consequences.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯太难以预测了。那里没有规则；他们也不相信规则，这可能会带来后果。

cues.en: Of course, there could be a new elite reaction—not from the people, but from those close to Putin.
cues.zh: 当然，也可能出现新的精英层反应——不是来自民众，而是来自普京身边的人。

cues.en: It might be dangerous for him. Sergey Petrov, ending that report by Ed Butler.
cues.zh: 这可能会对他构成危险。以上是谢尔盖·彼得罗夫的观点，埃德·巴特勒的报道到此结束。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast: the metaphor I use isn't the metaphor of a ladder,
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后还会谈到：我使用的隐喻不是梯子的隐喻，

cues.en: which, I think, is about climbing up the ladder.
cues.zh: 我想，那种隐喻讲的是沿着梯子往上爬。

cues.en: It's the metaphor of the weave: we weave our lives.
cues.zh: 而是编织的隐喻：我们编织自己的人生。

cues.en: How should we view our lives in the age of longevity?
cues.zh: 在长寿时代，我们该如何看待人生？

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《环球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Human rights groups in Turkey have accused the government of targeting the LGBT community after raids on gay bars and activists' homes.
cues.zh: 土耳其人权组织指责政府在突袭同性恋酒吧和活动人士住所后，针对 LGBT 群体展开打压。

cues.en: The crackdown is part of a campaign called 'My Family Is Safe,' which the government says is designed to protect traditional values.
cues.zh: 这场整治是“我的家庭很安全”运动的一部分。政府称，该运动旨在保护传统价值观。

cues.en: But critics call it state-led discrimination and a blatant violation of fundamental rights, taking the country down a dark path.
cues.zh: 但批评者称，这是国家主导的歧视，是对基本权利的公然侵犯，会让国家走上一条黑暗道路。

cues.en: My colleague Owen Bennett-Jones spoke to Emily Wither, a journalist based in Istanbul.
cues.zh: 我的同事欧文·贝内特-琼斯采访了常驻伊斯坦布尔的记者艾米莉·威瑟。

cues.en: What we've seen over the weekend is really unprecedented.
cues.zh: 我们这个周末看到的情况确实前所未有。

cues.en: There's never been a crackdown quite like this before.
cues.zh: 此前从未出现过如此规模的整治。

cues.en: The scale of the arrests is wide-ranging, and it's really sent a chill through the community here.
cues.zh: 逮捕行动范围很广，确实让这里的社群感到寒意。

cues.en: The Justice Minister says they've brought in 162 suspects.
cues.zh: 司法部长称，当局已带走162名嫌疑人。

cues.en: They've raided nine associations and 13 businesses across 15 provinces.
cues.zh: 他们突袭了9个协会和分布在15个省份的13家企业。

cues.en: The minister says this is a probe into prostitution and obscenity.
cues.zh: 部长称，这是针对卖淫和淫秽内容的调查。

cues.en: They've also shut down dozens of LGBTQ+ websites and social media accounts.
cues.zh: 当局还关闭了数十个 LGBTQ+ 网站和社交媒体账号。

cues.en: It's really wide-ranging.
cues.zh: 行动范围很广。

cues.en: Many raided associations were helping this community, which is heavily targeted here.
cues.zh: 许多遭突袭的协会都在帮助这个受严重打压的社群。

cues.en: Their support ranged from solidarity to mental-health services.
cues.zh: 提供的支持包括声援和心理健康服务。

cues.en: Many people from this community in Turkey tonight feel quite scared and worried about their future.
cues.zh: 今晚，土耳其这个社群中的许多人都感到害怕，也担忧自己的未来。

cues.en: So this is part of President Erdogan's, you know, long-running campaign to bolster family values, right?
cues.zh: 所以，这是埃尔多安总统长期推动、旨在巩固家庭价值观的行动的一部分，对吧？

cues.en: Yes, that's right. This crackdown is part of Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan's decade of family and population.
cues.zh: 是的，没错。这场整治属于土耳其总统塔伊普·埃尔多安发起的“家庭与人口十年”倡议。

cues.en: It's an initiative designed to tackle falling birth rates and an aging population in the country.
cues.zh: 这项倡议旨在应对该国出生率下降和人口老龄化。

cues.en: As in many countries, people in Turkey aren't having children as they used to.
cues.zh: 和许多国家一样，土耳其人如今生孩子也不像过去那么多了。

cues.en: The birth rate is below replacement level, and Erdogan encouraged people to have at least three children,
cues.zh: 出生率已低于更替水平，埃尔多安鼓励民众至少生三个孩子，

cues.en: promoting traditional family values and partly blaming the decline on the LGBTQ+ community.
cues.zh: 同时倡导传统家庭价值观，并把出生率下降部分归咎于 LGBTQ+ 群体。

cues.en: The government is offering financial incentives, but it isn't really working, partly because of a very challenging cost-of-living crisis.
cues.zh: 政府正在提供经济激励措施，但效果并不理想，部分原因是生活成本危机十分严峻。

cues.en: What are the laws on same-sex relationships? Is it illegal?
cues.zh: 同性关系在法律上如何规定？这违法吗？

cues.en: Turkey doesn't recognize same-sex marriage, but same-sex relations aren't an offense in Turkey.
cues.zh: 土耳其不承认同性婚姻，但同性关系在土耳其并不违法。

cues.en: But homophobia is common, and it's been tough for some time in Turkey.
cues.zh: 但恐同现象很普遍，土耳其的处境多年来一直很艰难。

cues.en: Pride was banned in 2015. People still come out and march at Pride, but they're met with tear gas and water cannon.
cues.zh: 骄傲游行于2015年被禁。人们仍会现身参加游行，但会遭到催泪瓦斯和水炮驱散。

cues.en: I've watched over the years as this community has increasingly been targeted.
cues.zh: 多年来，我亲眼看到这个社群遭到越来越多的针对。

cues.en: We now have direct messaging from the government targeting this community.
cues.zh: 如今，政府直接传递针对这个社群的信息。

cues.en: Effectively, hate speech against these communities has become acceptable in political discourse in a way it didn't used to be.
cues.zh: 实际上，针对这些社群的仇恨言论如今在政治话语中已变得可以接受，这在过去并非如此。

cues.en: This is also part of a wider crackdown we're seeing in Turkey this year.
cues.zh: 这也是今年土耳其正在发生的更广泛整治的一部分。

cues.en: It began with the political opposition,
cues.zh: 行动最初针对政治反对派，

cues.en: but lately has expanded to the LGBTQ+ community,
cues.zh: 但近来扩大到 LGBTQ+ 群体，

cues.en: as well as social media influencers, performers and business people.
cues.zh: 以及社交媒体网红、演艺人员和商界人士。

cues.en: A number of comedians have found themselves in trouble with the law recently.
cues.zh: 最近，不少喜剧演员都惹上了法律麻烦。

cues.en: So it's not just the opposition; it's now part of a wider crackdown that critics say targets anyone who challenges
cues.zh: 所以，这不只是针对反对派；批评者称，打击范围已扩大到任何挑战政府的人。

cues.en: the government's socially conservative view of how Turkey should be and how its public should behave.
cues.zh: 他们认为，政府正打击那些质疑土耳其应有面貌及公众行为的人。

cues.en: Emily Wither in Istanbul.
cues.zh: 伊斯坦布尔的艾米莉·威瑟报道。

cues.en: Now to a case that's gripped Italy for years.
cues.zh: 接下来是一个多年来牵动意大利的案件。

cues.en: A woman who testified against her own father after her mother was murdered in a notorious mafia killing is believed to have taken her own life.
cues.zh: 一名女子曾作证指控自己的父亲；她母亲在一起恶名昭彰的黑手党杀人案中被害，她本人据信也已自杀。

cues.en: Denise Cosco described herself as a proud witness for justice.
cues.zh: 丹妮丝·科斯科称自己是为正义作证的骄傲证人。

cues.en: She was found critically injured last Sunday and died a few days later in hospital.
cues.zh: 上周日有人发现她身受重伤，几天后她在医院去世。

cues.en: Anna Sergi is professor of sociology of law and deviance at the University of Bologna.
cues.zh: 安娜·塞尔吉是博洛尼亚大学法律社会学与越轨行为学教授。

cues.en: The death of Denise Cosco is the last episode, let's say, of a family saga.
cues.zh: 可以说，丹妮丝·科斯科之死是一个家族悲剧的最后一章。

cues.en: Denise's mother, Lea Garofalo, was probably one of the best-known women to take on the 'Ndrangheta,
cues.zh: 丹妮丝的母亲莱娅·加罗法洛，或许是反抗光荣会的知名女性之一；

cues.en: the Calabrian Mafia, by rebelling against her husband and leaving him and her family behind to give Denise a better life.
cues.zh: 她反抗丈夫，离开丈夫和家人，只为给丹妮丝更好的生活。

cues.en: But then she was killed by her husband, Denise's father.
cues.zh: 但后来，她被自己的丈夫、也就是丹妮丝的父亲杀害。

cues.en: The father is in prison. Denise chose to kill herself when she was 35, the same age her mother was when she was killed.
cues.zh: 她的父亲如今在狱中。丹妮丝选择在35岁时结束生命；她母亲遇害时也正是这个年纪。

cues.en: So it's highly symbolic. Denise's story is fairly complicated,
cues.zh: 所以这极具象征意义。丹妮丝的故事相当复杂，

cues.en: because she chose to go back to her father's family
cues.zh: 因为她曾选择回到父亲的家庭，

cues.en: at the beginning, when things were unsettled and she didn't yet know what her father had done.
cues.zh: 起初，事情尚未明朗，她也还不知道父亲做过什么。

cues.en: So she lived with the ambiguity of her mother being seen as a saint and idealised as an anti-mafia hero,
cues.zh: 因此，她一直活在这种矛盾中：母亲被视为圣人、被理想化为反黑手党的英雄，

cues.en: and her father as the monster who killed her. This is very difficult for anyone growing up.
cues.zh: 而父亲却是杀害母亲的恶人。这对任何一个成长中的人都极其艰难。

cues.en: The reason Carlo Cosco, her father, was in jail is that Denise had testified.
cues.zh: 她父亲卡洛·科斯科入狱，是因为丹妮丝曾出庭作证。

cues.en: So she was under witness protection, which meant she lived away under a new identity in a secure location,
cues.zh: 因此她受到证人保护，以新身份住在安全地点，与外界隔离；

cues.en: constantly checked on by protection services to make sure nothing unusual happened in her routine.
cues.zh: 保护人员还会持续监控她，确保日常生活没有异常。

cues.en: This must have been extremely demanding for her.
cues.zh: 这对她来说一定极其煎熬。

cues.en: It's still about the dangers she was, of course, facing from the organisation she took on,
cues.zh: 这还涉及她所面对的危险——当然，危险来自她所对抗的组织；

cues.en: but at the same time, she probably needed more support to overcome her internal and family history.
cues.zh: 但与此同时，她或许更需要支持，去克服内心挣扎及家族历史带来的影响。

cues.en: Anna Sergi. The Israeli culture minister has said he'll take immediate action to revoke the citizenship of two Israeli directors of NAZA.
cues.zh: 安娜·塞尔吉。以色列文化部长称，他将立即采取行动，撤销纪录片《NAZA》两名以色列导演的公民身份。

cues.en: The documentary examines the AI-driven system the Israeli military uses to carry out attacks in Gaza.
cues.zh: 这部纪录片审视以色列军方用于在加沙实施攻击的人工智能系统。

cues.en: On Saturday, NAZA won a special jury prize at the prestigious Venice Film Festival, where it received a 25-minute standing ovation.
cues.zh: 周六，《NAZA》在著名的威尼斯电影节上获得评审团特别奖，并获全场起立鼓掌25分钟。

cues.en: Sebastian Usher reports.
cues.zh: 塞巴斯蒂安·厄舍报道。

cues.en: In an angry tweet, Israeli Culture Minister Miki Zohar accused Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor of having betrayed the State of Israel.
cues.zh: 以色列文化部长米基·佐哈尔在一条愤怒的推文中，指责尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和蕾切尔·索尔背叛以色列。

cues.en: He called NAZA's Venice prize shocking, and said its directors were prepared to harm their homeland just to win applause from anti-Semites.
cues.zh: 他称《NAZA》在威尼斯获奖令人震惊，并说导演们为了赢得反犹分子的掌声，竟愿意伤害自己的祖国。

cues.en: Mr Zohar doesn't himself have the power to revoke their citizenship, but the mechanism to take such action does exist in Israeli law.
cues.zh: 佐哈尔本人无权撤销他们的公民身份，但以色列法律确实设有采取此类行动的机制。

cues.en: NAZA takes its name from an acronym the Israeli military uses to denote how many civilians
cues.zh: NAZA这个名称来自以色列军方使用的一个缩写，用来表示平民人数，

cues.en: are expected to be killed in a strike targeting a Hamas member in Gaza.
cues.zh: 即针对加沙哈马斯成员的打击预计会造成多少平民死亡。

cues.en: The film is based on testimony from disillusioned Israeli intelligence officers speaking on condition of anonymity.
cues.zh: 影片根据心灰意冷的以色列情报人员的证词拍摄，他们是在匿名条件下发言的。

cues.en: Sebastian Usher.
cues.zh: 塞巴斯蒂安·厄舍。

cues.en: Alexander Zverev has won the men's US Open, his second Grand Slam tennis title of the year.
cues.zh: 亚历山大·兹维列夫赢得美国网球公开赛男单冠军，这是他本年度第二个大满贯网球冠军。

cues.en: The German beat America's Ben Shelton in four sets, and it was a bizarre ending.
cues.zh: 这位德国选手四盘击败美国选手本·谢尔顿，比赛以一种离奇的方式结束。

cues.en: Zverev didn't realise he'd won when Shelton hit a return long on championship point.
cues.zh: 在冠军点上，谢尔顿回球出界，兹维列夫却没意识到自己已经获胜。

cues.en: Our correspondent Russell Fuller was watching from the commentator's box at Flushing Meadows.
cues.zh: 我们的记者拉塞尔·富勒当时正在法拉盛草地的解说席观看比赛。

cues.en: He spoke to Ankur Desai.
cues.zh: 他与安库尔·德赛交谈。

cues.en: None of us have ever seen anything quite like that at the end of a Grand Slam final.
cues.zh: 我们从未在大满贯决赛结束时见过这样的场面。

cues.en: You hear players say, "I'm not really looking at the scoreboard, just focused on holding and breaking serve." That seemed to be Zverev's issue.
cues.zh: 你会听到球员说：“我不太看记分牌，只专注于保发和破发。”这似乎就是兹维列夫的问题。

cues.en: He genuinely didn't realise he'd crossed the line, so the celebrations were delayed.
cues.zh: 他确实没意识到自己已经获胜，所以庆祝迟了一会儿。

cues.en: But the celebrations were deserved; he was the better player that night.
cues.zh: 不过，这场胜利他当之无愧；那晚他确实表现得更好。

cues.en: He's playing like a man with the experience of finally winning a Grand Slam title,
cues.zh: 他现在的表现，像是终于赢得过大满贯冠军、积累了经验的球员；

cues.en: winning his first at age 29 at Roland Garros in Paris, at the French Open in June.
cues.zh: 他29岁时在巴黎罗兰·加洛斯球场赢得首个大满贯，也就是六月的法国网球公开赛。

cues.en: He was forced into a fourth set by Ben Shelton, the 23-year-old American, but won it comfortably, six games to two.
cues.zh: 23岁的美国选手本·谢尔顿把比赛拖入第四盘，但兹维列夫以6比2轻松取胜。

cues.en: He handled the pro-American crowd in New York superbly and executed his game plan in the final.
cues.zh: 他出色地应对了纽约支持美国选手的观众，并在决赛中贯彻了自己的战术。

cues.en: Russell, he's often been the nearly man in men's tennis, but this year he's really filled the gap
cues.zh: 拉塞尔，他在男子网坛常常功亏一篑，但今年确实填补了空缺，

cues.en: when Alcaraz and Sinner, the two real titans of tennis, have been either injured or absent from Grand Slams.
cues.zh: 因为阿尔卡拉斯和辛纳这两位网坛巨头不是受伤，就是缺席了大满贯赛事。

cues.en: He's really capitalized. Yes, absolutely.
cues.zh: 他确实抓住了机会。是的，完全如此。

cues.en: He has taken his opportunity wonderfully well.
cues.zh: 他把握住了这次机会，表现得非常出色。

cues.en: There was no Carlos Alcaraz at the French Open.
cues.zh: 阿尔卡拉斯没有参加法国网球公开赛。

cues.en: Jannik Sinner was beaten in the heat of the second round and was very nervous for much of the championship,
cues.zh: 扬尼克·辛纳在第二轮高温中落败，比赛大部分时间都显得很紧张，

cues.en: but he still won a fifth set against Flavio Cobolli.
cues.zh: 但他还是在与弗拉维奥·科博利的比赛中赢下了第五盘。

cues.en: At the US Open, with Carlos Alcaraz just returning from injury and Jannik Sinner absent,
cues.zh: 而在美国网球公开赛上，阿尔卡拉斯刚刚伤愈复出，辛纳则缺席，

cues.en: Zverev again benefited from a very favorable draw.
cues.zh: 兹维列夫再次抽到了非常有利的签位。

cues.en: Ben Shelton was the first top-20 player he had to beat,
cues.zh: 他要击败的首位世界排名前二十的选手是本·谢尔顿，

cues.en: and despite being taken to five sets in both the first and second rounds,
cues.zh: 尽管他在第一轮和第二轮都被拖入五盘大战，

cues.en: he improved throughout the tournament. His best performance came in the final, and he saved it for then.
cues.zh: 他的状态在整个赛事中不断提升。锦标赛最佳表现出现在决赛，他把这一表现留到了最后。

cues.en: A word on Ben Shelton, an exciting prospect for American tennis.
cues.zh: 再说说本·谢尔顿，他是美国网球的一位令人期待的新秀。

cues.en: He'll be hoping to come back and try to claim that trophy one more time.
cues.zh: 他希望再次回来，争取再拿一次冠军。

cues.en: Yes, the American men's Grand Slam drought will extend into a 24th year.
cues.zh: 是的，美国男选手的网球大满贯冠军荒将延续到第24个年头。

cues.en: Andy Roddick was the last American man to win a Grand Slam here, at the US Open in 2003.
cues.zh: 安迪·罗迪克是最后一位赢得大满贯的美国男选手，他于2003年在美网夺冠。

cues.en: But Ben Shelton beat Carlos Alcaraz in the quarterfinals and reached his first Grand Slam final,
cues.zh: 但本·谢尔顿在四分之一决赛中击败了阿尔卡拉斯，并首次闯入大满贯决赛，

cues.en: with many years of his career ahead and having matured in his game and approach to matches,
cues.zh: 他的职业生涯还很长，球技和比赛心态也成熟了许多，

cues.en: so American fans can be optimistic he'll reach this position again,
cues.zh: 因此美国球迷可以乐观地期待他再次打进这样的阶段，

cues.en: That very long drought, by American standards, isn't an issue on the women's side,
cues.zh: 这段按美国标准算很长的冠军荒，在女子网球方面并不存在，

cues.en: where US players have dominated. The men's drought should end at some point in the next few years.
cues.zh: 美国女选手一直占据优势；男选手的冠军荒也有望在未来几年内结束。

cues.en: Russell Fuller in New York.
cues.zh: 鲁塞尔·富勒在纽约报道。

cues.en: We are living longer than ever on average, but how should we make the most of those extra years?
cues.zh: 我们平均寿命比以往更长，但该如何充分利用多出来的这些年？

cues.en: Professor Linda Gratton has researched this for her new book, Living the 100-Year Life, about living and working in an age of longevity.
cues.zh: 琳达·格拉顿教授为新书《百岁人生》研究了长寿时代的生活与工作。

cues.en: She says aging isn't like climbing a ladder, but more like weaving a cloth that evolves with us.
cues.zh: 她说，变老不像爬梯子，更像编织一块会随我们不断变化的布。

cues.en: We used to think of our lives, especially our working lives, as three stages: full-time education, work and retirement.
cues.zh: 过去我们认为人生，尤其是职业生涯，分为三个阶段：全日制教育、全职工作和全职退休。

cues.en: But imagine retiring at 60 and then living to 90.
cues.zh: 但想想看，如果你60岁退休，然后活到90岁。

cues.en: That's a long time on the golf course, with little interaction.
cues.zh: 那会是在高尔夫球场上度过的漫长岁月，也可能缺少交流。

cues.en: So I ask three questions. First: who am I?
cues.zh: 所以我会问三个问题。第一个：我是谁？

cues.en: What do I want to do with my life?
cues.zh: 我想用这一生做什么？

cues.en: Second: where am I now? That's where the threads come in.
cues.zh: 第二：我现在身处何处？这就要看维系人生的线索。

cues.en: You can look at the threads that hold your life together.
cues.zh: 你可以看看那些将人生串联起来的线索。

cues.en: The third question is: what actions could I take right now?
cues.zh: 第三个问题是：此刻我可以采取什么行动？

cues.en: And what promises might I make to my future self?
cues.zh: 我又能对未来的自己作出什么承诺？

cues.en: Friendship is the one thing we know predicts whether you'll have a great life.
cues.zh: 我们知道，友情是预示一个人能否拥有美好人生的重要因素。

cues.en: Anyone, anywhere in the world, can turn around right now and spend eight minutes with a friend.
cues.zh: 世界上任何地方的任何人，现在都可以转过身来，和朋友相处八分钟。

cues.en: We know eight minutes with a friend strengthens that thread of friendship.
cues.zh: 我们知道，和朋友相处八分钟能加强这条友情纽带。

cues.en: These threads aren't just about making money.
cues.zh: 这些人生线索不只是关于赚钱。

cues.en: They're also about staying calm and having adventures.
cues.zh: 它们也关乎保持平静、体验冒险。

cues.en: All the choices we want to make can change over time.
cues.zh: 随着时间推移，我们想作出的各种选择都可能改变。

cues.en: For example, people once thought, “If I want to start a business,”
cues.zh: 例如，人们过去会想：“如果我想创业，

cues.en: “I've got to start young—at 20, at 21.”
cues.zh: “那就得趁年轻，20岁、21岁就开始。”

cues.en: Research now shows the most successful entrepreneurs who start businesses are in their forties.
cues.zh: 如今的创业研究显示，最成功的创业者创业时都已年届四十。

cues.en: So this is a great opportunity to think about your life without centering it on your age.
cues.zh: 所以这是个很好的机会，让你思考人生时不再以年龄为中心。

cues.en: I've seen more and more people take sabbaticals in their forties and fifties, and really step away.
cues.zh: 我看到越来越多人在四五十岁时休长假，真正暂时抽身离开。

cues.en: Of course, you can do that if you're going to work until your seventies,
cues.zh: 当然，如果你打算工作到七十多岁，就可以这样做，

cues.en: and that's what I think we'll be doing. Then it makes sense to redistribute some retirement years.
cues.zh: 我认为很多人都会如此。这样一来，重新分配部分退休年限就很合理。

cues.en: But also take some education years and redistribute them.
cues.zh: 也重新分配部分教育年限。

cues.en: Professor Linda Gratton.
cues.zh: 琳达·格拉顿教授。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 我们今天的节目就到这里。

cues.en: If you want to get in touch, email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 如果你想联系我们，可以给我们发邮件：globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also find us on X.
cues.zh: 你也可以在X上找到我们。

cues.en: At BBC World Service, use the hashtag Global News Pod.
cues.zh: 关注BBC World Service，并使用话题标签Global News Pod。

cues.en: And don't forget our sibling podcast, The Global Story, which goes in depth and beyond the headlines on one big story.
cues.zh: 别忘了我们的姊妹播客《全球故事》，它会围绕一个大主题深入探究，超越新闻标题。

cues.en: This edition of the Global News Podcast was mixed by Rose Enwin Doral, and produced by Muzaffer Shakir.
cues.zh: 本期《全球新闻播客》由Rose Enwin Doral负责混音，制作人是Muzaffer Shakir。

cues.en: The editor is Karen Martin. I'm Alex Ritson.
cues.zh: 编辑是Karen Martin。我是亚历克斯·里特森。

cues.en: Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 下次再见。
